title: 224쪽 · Floating to Stab
sourcePageBasis: capture sequence, checked against surrounding folios
paragraphs: Pro tip: Float against people who c-bet and quit too Often,
$5-$10NL: The Cutoff raises to $30. Hero calls.

As discussed earlier, very few players double barrel at a high enough frequency on ace high boards. There’s a huge gap between their c-betting frequency and turn betting frequency on static textures. You should seek to exploit this by floating in these spots.
Villain checks. Hero bets $30. Villain calls.
